task_name: World 471 Task A  -  BenAdmin EDI Section 125 Post-Tax Domestic Partner Gap & Medical Details Bridge
prompt: Review the Medical_Details_And_Sec125 schedule in `benadmin_ease_vs_payroll_nov2026.xlsx`. Reconcile raw medical premiums after voluntary drops and terminations, compute modeled monthly and annualized employer medical savings, quantify any omitted post-tax domestic partner deduction from the EDI sync, and explain the governing IRC Section 125 tax treatment.

rubric.description: Reconciles raw medical $29,184.11 less -$4,272.68 voluntary drops and -$965.71 terminations to $23,945.72 across 34 active enrollees ($5,390.85 ER and $5,661.02 EE per pay period).
Computes modeled employer medical savings of $2,619.24 per month ($31,430.88 annualized) from the 6 voluntary drops and 2 Details-tab terminations.

Identifies the $291.11 per-pay-period ($630.74 monthly / $7,568.86 annual) post-tax domestic partner deduction omitted when EDI syncs only $207.66 pre-tax out of $498.77 total EE ($706.43 total with $207.66 ER).
Explains that under IRC Section 125 non-tax-dependent domestic partner medical coverage cannot be deducted pre-tax and requires a separate post-tax payroll deduction code or imputed income mapping.
